notes.title: Bunch more updates!
notes.content:
Hi  everyone, we have just finished (hopefully) adding and fixing more stuff. The checkpoints should now be fully functional with no wierd glitches like what people were seeing. We have implemented some much needed preformance updates to make the game run much smoother. Finally as per request we have added cheat codes! We have added several different (listed below) that you can type into the game at any point in any level. IMPORTANT NOTE THOUGH: If you activate a cheat code you CANNOT unlock anything that includes things in game and Steam achivments. You have to delete your save file to be able to get any unlockables and achivements. With all that said please enjoy the game and please do let us know if there are any issues.

Again you just type the code in to activate it, there is no special cheats box or anything like that. Also you can undo some of the codes by typing it in again and also also some codes only last for that level while others last forever. Good luck! :D

fox swap = rule63plz
less gravity = unlaidenfox
lots of lives = over9000foxes
hardmode = steppingonlegos
get one life = mulligan
superspeed = 10secondsflat
cant get hurt/die = indomitablefox

Stay fresh cheese bags!

notes.title: Fitz the Fox Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey guys Fitz the Fox just got a little update with a really cool feature that I think we've needed for a while. In this update we've added checkpoints! So now the game feels a bit more fair. 

We've also added a few fixes with the color mode and have set the groundwork for some more cool things in the future.

Enjoy and thanks for play :)

notes.title: Minor Bug fix and Soundtrack!!!!1!
notes.content: We are slowly adding content and fixing the bugs that you guys are pointing out to us. (Thanks for all of the feedback by the way) One of the issues was that clouds were not giving out points like they were supposed to. Also, we have included the soundtrack by popular demand. Hope you guys enjoy, there are some more big things happening in the very near future. He have some major plans that we hope to reveal soon!

notes.title: Indie Royal key request
notes.content:
Well it looks like no one will be getting any keys from Indie Royal.
If you bought our game in IndieRoyale Bedut 25 Bundle here's what you need to know to get a Fitz key. 

Send an email to admin@breadvisionstudios.com with the subject line "Indie Royal key request" and attach some kind of proof of purchace such as a screen shot of you playing fitz or a link to your profile. whatever is fine. 

I'll do my best to get back to everyone I can until Evan gets back from Bronycon -.-

notes.title: Fitz the Fox release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Evan Spiker head producer of Bread Vision Studios.  I just wanted to say how excited we are for Fitz to finally hit Steam and to thank everyone that gave Fitz the upvote in greenlight. As you know we wouldn't be here now if not for you guys. <3

Now for the people who bough the game through the Indie Royal bundle with the promise of the steam key we are attempting to get in contact with desura about this but from what we know they will still be able to provide everyone with thier keys. If not we will work to get everyone their rightful steam key. I will post updates on both our site and here check back to keep up to date with all of this.

Thanks again for all your support and we really hope you like Fitz the Fox! :D
